source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Νικήτας ο Σιναΐτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and then says in one sentence that there is no information about his life. **No year, so no `dates` object.** **He is none of the corpus's fifteen Nicetases**: none of them is called ο Σιναΐτης and none is kept on 12 May. The page's glossary block about a seventh-century Byzantine general of the name is one of its standing name notes and is not a statement about this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
